selection: Use repetition 1, earliest machine-valid attempt. Never replace it with a better repetition. Repetitions 2 and 3 measure contract/preflight repeatability only unless independently rendered and reviewed.
repair: At most one fresh request with the same original packet, own previous answer and verbatim deterministic validation error. No human or other-model advice. No semantic repairs after visual review.
limitations: One topic is not a general model ranking or a classroom learning-outcome study.
Shared components, typography, layout and TTS are engineering inputs, not model-authored capabilities.
Provider hidden policies, tokenizers and reasoning implementations cannot be made identical.
Codex CLI has no equivalent hard max_completion_tokens flag; shared wall-time and answer-character limits apply, and actual usage is reported.
Codex uses subscription authentication; public API-equivalent cost is an estimate, not the subscription bill.
Independent review is a shared evaluation service, not a candidate self-review or repair helper.

pricing.basis: Standard short-context API equivalent; subscription bill unknown
Report peak/off-peak estimate interval; not reconciled billing
Default 5-minute cache; bound unknown cache-write charge separately, not reconciled billing
